story: The Trade of the Century: When George Soros Broke the British Pound
text: A pretty good documentary from the BBC about Black Wednesday. Shows more from the government side and the mistakes they made than Soros part but still gives you a good understanding of what happened. [VIDEO]

text: [VIDEO] a good overview of the origins of the crisis. how politicians for their own shortsighted gains made one poor decision after another and led the country into financial crisis.

story: When George Soros Broke the British Pound (2014)
text: This incident was the main reason the UK didn't enter the Euro. This wonderful BBC documentary explains everything on detail. [VIDEO]

story: When George Soros Broke the British Pound (2014)
text: The only reason he could put on the trade in the size that he did was because the BoE took the other side (they sold $27bn worth of £ and Soros had a $10bn position) and believed they were omnipotent (even amongst British civil servants, the BoE was unusually stacked with "god complex" types...and still is to a certain extent). Documentary on this - [VIDEO]
